digest.component_or_area: LLM gate verdict signing and provenance tracking
propositions: Signed gate verdicts must record provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities as a new sibling provider_provenance object alongside the existing model string field to disambiguate verdicts produced behind opaque gateways (e.g., Bedrock-backed vs Anthropic-backed).

The provider_provenance record must be assembled once in runner.run() reusing the capabilities already resolved at that call site, then threaded through finalize_verdict into all three sidecar payload writers (plan-review, completion, code-review), never recomputed.
The endpoint_host must be extracted via urlparse(base_url).hostname to strip userinfo, never .netloc, ensuring no credentials from base_url or api_key reach the persisted signed payload.
The tier field must distinguish first_class (direct provider) from best_effort (custom base_url), defined as a design decision, enabling consumers to reject off-tier verdicts.
The change must be additive-only and backward-compatible: legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance must load and verify, and readers without the key treat it as unknown.
Story 2932 (supports_temperature field) must land first to complete the capabilities record before any payload is signed, preventing divergence between signed verdicts.
